source_text: Quidquid tetigerit altare sanctificabitur. Altare Christus; contactus fidei. Accedite ad lapidem vivum.
pass_a_gloss: Whatever will-have-touched altar will-be-sanctified. Altar Christ; contact of-faith. Approach to stone living.
pass_b_english: [[Whatever touches the altar becomes holy >> Bible:Exodus 29:37]]. The altar is Christ; the touch is faith. Come to the [[living stone >> Bible:1 Peter 2:4]].
